summary: Report of a court order violation on Peerless Avenue; deputies found no violation.
Court order call on Oregon Street drew about 15 people; no weapons were seen and no violation was confirmed.
Mini-bike and vehicle collided at Bliss and Texas streets; two people were hurt, one of them in the roadway.
Two-vehicle crash left the roadway blocked.
Assault reported in the 1300 block of California Avenue; the victim was in a wheelchair and the other man left on foot.
Man armed with a knife refused to drop it during a standoff. Officers held the scene and detained him about 35 minutes later; charges including assault with a deadly weapon were requested.
Caller reported five people shooting firearms into the air on Pond Road, with a gray Volkswagen, a black truck and a red Chevrolet seen leaving.
A driver suspected of being under the influence tried to run from a crash; witnesses held him on the sidewalk until officers arrived.
Shots heard behind a Chevron on the 11,000 block of Highway 178; callers put five to seven people on ATVs.
Driver found slumped and unresponsive but breathing in a car at a Mount Vernon Avenue store.
Airport police called for extra units at Meadows Field over a report of a possible firearm; a man in a black hoodie walked toward employee parking. The terminal was held and cleared within minutes.
Man reported hitting windows on Center Street with a machete he kept in his vehicle.
Juveniles were lighting items on fire in front of the Jamison Children's Center on Calloway Drive.
A semi struck a fire hydrant at a Dennis McCarthy Drive store, sending water across the lot.
Vehicle fire on Mayer Avenue just south of Sullivan Road.
Trash can fire across from a store at Chester Avenue and 24th Street.
Multiple callers reported a fire larger than a vehicle near Tuscan Villas Drive and Alfred Harrell Highway.
Resident on Columbus Street heard footsteps in the attic and believed someone pushed a door closed.
Woman found in the roadway on Kern Canyon Road, apparently under the influence and asleep.
U-Haul truck burned across from an address on Lake Street.
Smoke reported on Niles Street just east of Fairfax Road.
Structure fire assignment went out with fire and ambulance units responding.
Fire reported near Elm Street and the Golden State frontage road.
Single-vehicle rollover at a travel stop on East Tehachapi Boulevard; an air ambulance was placed on standby.
Minor injuries after fight at Stockdale and River.
Person with traumatic injury at Cherry Acres.
Crash involving Nissan on Harris Road.
Car fire after crash near Olive Drive on Highway 99.
Tow requested after crash damages guardrail.
Hit-and-run crash involving two vehicles.
Officers respond to crash on Gosford Road.
